claim: ID Medal Locations - Jake/Sherry Chapter 3 : r/residentevil - Reddit
summary: If you put all 16 in the Buddha statue it unlocks the golden gate giving you the Bear Commander before Chapter 4, about 4000 skill points and some destructible boxes. You'll get this assault rifle as a reward for finishing Chapter 3 as its necessary for Chapter 4 but I like completing all the little side quests. There's also a medal in the Chapter summary for collecting all 16 ID Medals.
